'''Cadrin's Sanctuary''' was a rural property on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Vandor-3]] owned by [[Cadrin Awel]], a former [[Musician/Legends|singer]]. Established shortly before the [[Second Galactic Civil War]], it operated as a boot camp where city-folk from planets like [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] could learn wilderness survival skills. To advertise the sanctuary, promotional materials highlighted Awel's experience living off the land during the [[Yuuzhan Vong War]].<ref name="MK">''[[X-Wing: Mercy Kill]]''</ref>
